status: illustration, not a measured cluster migration or vendor hardware quote
units: Decimal KB/GB/TB; binary KiB/GiB only where explicitly labeled

lavik.topology: one primary plus two full followers; one Meta voter per physical host

capacityModel: Redis = 2*ceil(payload_TB*1000/(10*0.7)); Lavik = 3 hosts through 10.752 TB if index RAM, overhead, throughput, recovery and fault constraints all fit.
important: The same 1.5 TB logical payload would require 430 Redis nodes at a 70% value budget, not 300. 300-to-3 compares the stated fleet with a candidate storage topology. No 10 TB, replicated, failure-state or P99.99 SLA performance has been measured here.
